registeredSourceTerm.description: Narrowing for the source terms that Neko-TOP registers: a case file cannot use them, so none of the five types is accepted.
registeredSourceTerm.$comment: sources/source_terms/neko_top_source_terms.f90:71-78 registers the five types. Neko's factory allocates the type and calls its init_from_json (neko src/source_terms/source_term_fctry.f90:80-86,124-130), which is empty for all five (simple_brinkman_source_term.f90:110-123 and its siblings): no fields, coefficients or pointers are set, so the first compute_ dereferences them (simple_brinkman_source_term.f90:214-216,280). They are built in code with init_from_components only. This narrows Neko's custom-type branch through allOf and widens nothing.
